The ticket is #8841. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

Tobias raised it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27), a channel Pree is in. He wrote that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

Tobias didn't actually say "Marrow Fieldworks." He was talking about "Tobias's dealer account" (the Plains depots). I connected the two using the Jan 2 Central handoff digest, which says Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and moved to someone else on Jan 5. That's an inference, so my reply suggests she confirm with Tobias before the call. I also told her not to mix it up with #88412, an older ticket for a different customer's door.

I only used channels and public files Pree can see herself.
